Feel free to browse my selection of the latest and greatest module furnishings and accessories, certainly fit for any great Padawan or Jedi!|H0-U53|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''H0-U53''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The droid sold furniture.

==Behind the scenes==
The droid's name is a reference to the word "house".
